usage.callShape: POST https://convert.kasandell.workers.dev/convert/audio with a RAW BINARY audio body (the audio file bytes themselves, NOT JSON), Content-Type: audio/mpeg (or matching the file format). Pay via x402 (USDC on Base, eip155:8453, $0.003).

inputExample._note: Body is NOT JSON. Send raw audio file bytes (e.g. an MP3) as the POST body with Content-Type: audio/mpeg. Supported: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, WebM.

quirks: Body must be RAW BINARY audio bytes, NOT JSON. Empty inputSchema in registry is misleading — the real input is the audio file itself in the request body.
Content-Type must be audio/* (decoded payment-required bazaar extension specifies audio/mpeg, bodyType=binary). Supported formats: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, WebM.

COULD NOT VERIFY via the money-safe qa-pay tool: that tool reads --body=@file as UTF-8 text and forwards a string to wallet.paidFetch, which irreversibly corrupts binary audio. A pay primitive with binary-body support is required to test this endpoint.
Endpoint appears live and well-formed: probe returns 402 with valid x402 accepts (USDC/Base, payTo 0x043b8aa7e75068F92696c8831801587Fc105A8d8, amount 3000 = $0.003) and a clear {text} output schema.
usage.guide: Transcribe audio to text. POST the raw bytes of an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, or WebM) directly as the request body to https://convert.kasandell.workers.dev/convert/audio with Content-Type set to the audio type (e.g. audio/mpeg) — do NOT wrap it in JSON. Pay $0.003 USDC on Base via x402. The response is JSON; read the transcription from body.text. NOTE: this was not paid-verified because the QA pay tool cannot transmit a binary body without UTF-8 corruption.
